description: Deterministically resolve a folder, list eligible (CONVERTED) videos, estimate the dubbing cost in credits, and optionally create AI dubbing jobs for one or more target languages. dry_run=true (default) returns a preview without creating any job. standard mode = 5 credits/min, lipsync = 14 credits/min, per language (minimum 1 min; a partial minute counts only past 1 s). Skips videos that already have the other dubbing technology (standard and lipsync can't be mixed) and, in lipsync, videos over 60 minutes. Each video follows its subtitles like the dashboard: targets already subtitled get audio only (DUBBING), the others TRANSLATION (source subtitled) or TRANSCRIPTION + dubbing. Stops at the first insufficient-credits (402) answer and lists the videos not attempted.

dry_run.description: true = preview only; false = create jobs

folder_ref.description: Folder name, ID, or dashboard URL

from_lang.description: Source language code (default 'auto' = each video's original language)

idempotency_key.description: Reserved client-supplied key to make retries safe (not yet enforced server-side)

target_langs.description: Target language codes to dub into, e.g. ['en','es']

name: panda_action_dub_folder_videos
title: Dub Folder Videos
